title: Java Expanded
description: This mod adds new advancements, structures, and more to come!
body:
Ever thought Vanilla Minecraft was too plain? Well, this should kind of help with that.
Java Expanded adds a handful of nice things to the game while definitely keeping the Vanilla feel.
(This is only a prototype, so it's not the best version.)

   Additions include:
- A new structure
- A small handful of advancements
- 1 Painting

Yeah, that's pretty much it lol.

(Also, there are older versions of the mod listed on CurseForge. So, if there's any confusion surrounding versions, there are 3 older versions available.)

CurseForge Link:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/java-expanded
